title: 第1926章 陈观楼吃瘪第1925章 当爹的心虚
content_zh:
“母亲，我偷偷告诉你，父亲已经晋升宗师。”
宋成雨凑在宋安许耳边，兴奋地说出小秘密。
父亲只是叮嘱他不许跟外人说这个秘密，母亲又不是外人。所以，告诉母亲应该没事吧。
“当真？”
宋安许意外极了，这才几年时间，陈观楼竟然晋升宗师。
“父亲亲口说的，肯定假不了。父亲好生厉害！母亲，我将来能不能像父亲那般厉害？”
“这得问你父亲。你有武脉，资质如何，你父亲肯定清楚。”
“我一会就去问父亲。”
宋成雨兴奋地跑走了。
宋安许问下人，“陈大人在何处？”
“启禀世子女，陈大人这会在校场，考教大公子的武艺。”
宋安许闻言，当即前往校场。
璐王宗亲一脉，少有人拥有武脉。即便有，资质也很普通。
或许是陈观楼的基因太过优秀，宋成霖跟宋成雨两兄弟都有武脉，而且资质还行。称不上天赋卓绝，也算是中上之姿。
为此，宋安许还曾在已故璐王面前讨要好处，夸自己找的男人好，生出来的孩子都如此优秀。比之已故璐王给她找的男人强多了。
已故璐王无法反驳，两个孙子的优秀肉眼可见，绝非亲妈滤镜。
为了两个孙子，他心甘情愿将王府兵权交给宋安许，为两个孙子保驾护航。
任何人都有可能伤害两个孙子，唯独宋安许不会。
宋安许带着人来到校场，只见陈观楼正在提点宋成霖的功法武艺。
她上前关心：“怎么样，累不累？”

“多谢母亲关心，儿子不累。”宋成霖表现得很沉稳，但毕竟年纪小，内心的雀跃还是掩饰不住。
宋安许拿出手绢替大儿子擦汗水，“出了一身汗，快去洗漱。”
“儿子遵命！”宋成霖带着一帮小厮护卫，欢快地离开。
宋安许挥挥手，伺候的人纷纷后退十步。
她小声问道：“成雨告诉我，你晋升宗师了？”
“对！”
“什么时候的事？”
“好几年前。”
“这么大的事，你都没告诉我。”宋安许嗔怪道。
陈观楼搂着她的肩，往回走。
“头几年，我谁都没告诉。后来被大相寺的了无大师看破，又被宫里的魏无病周墨白知晓，我才有限的告诉了几人。如今，你也是有限的几人之一。”
宋安许轻笑一声，略感满意，“恭喜你晋升宗师。以你如今的实力，对上魏周二人，可有把握？”
“没有打赢的把握，有保命的把握。告诉你一个好消息，去年，我打了周墨白一巴掌，他没反应过来。”
宋安许捂住嘴惊呼，“你竟然打了周墨白耳光？他，他还没反应过来？他是老了还是快要死了，反应这么慢吗？”
陈观楼发现，宋安许偶尔也很毒舌。两个人果然很合拍。
content_en:
"Mother, let me tell you secretly that my father has been promoted to master."
Song Chengyu leaned into Song Anxu's ear and excitedly told her little secret.
His father just told him not to tell this secret to outsiders, and his mother was not an outsider. So, it should be fine if you tell your mother.
"Seriously?"
Song Anxu was extremely surprised. In just a few years, Chen Guanlou was promoted to Grandmaster.
"What my father said himself cannot be false. My father is so powerful! Mother, can I be as powerful as my father in the future?"
"You have to ask your father about this. You have martial arts background and your qualifications. Your father will definitely know."
"I'll ask my father soon."
Song Chengyu ran away excitedly.
Song Anxu asked his servant, "Where is Mr. Chen?"
"To my children, Mr. Chen will be at the school to test the eldest son's martial arts."
After Song Anxu heard this, he immediately went to the school grounds.
There are very few people in King Lu's family lineage who have martial arts. Even if there is, the qualifications are very ordinary.
Perhaps Chen Guanlou's genes are too good. The two brothers, Song Chenglin and Song Chengyu, both have martial arts backgrounds and have decent qualifications. It can't be called an outstanding talent, but it can be regarded as an above-average appearance.
For this reason, Song Anxu also asked for favors from the late King Lu, praising him for finding a good man and giving birth to such excellent children. Much better than the man the late King Lu found for her.
The late King Lu could not refute that the excellence of her two grandsons was visible to the naked eye and was definitely not filtered by her biological mother.
For the sake of his two grandsons, he willingly handed over the military power of the palace to Song Anxu to protect his two grandsons.
Anyone could hurt the two grandchildren, but Song Anxu would not.
Song Anxu led people to the school grounds and saw Chen Guanlou teaching Song Chenglin some skills and martial arts.
She stepped forward and asked, "How are you, are you tired?"
"Thank you for your concern, mother. My son is not tired." Song Chenglin acted very calmly, but after all, he was young and could not hide his excitement.
Song Anxu took out a handkerchief to wipe his eldest son's sweat, "You're sweating all over, go and wash up quickly."
"Son, I obey!" Song Chenglin left happily with a group of boys to protect him.
Song Anxu waved his hand, and the people serving him took ten steps back.
She asked in a low voice: "Chengyu told me that you were promoted to Grandmaster?"
"Yes!"
"When did it happen?"
"Several years ago."
"You didn't tell me such a big thing." Song Anxu said angrily.
Chen Guanlou put his arm around her shoulders and walked back.
"In the first few years, I didn't tell anyone. Later, Master Liao Wu of Daxiang Temple saw through it, and Wei Wubing and Zhou Mobai in the palace found out about it, so I told a limited number of people. Now, you are also one of the limited people."
Song Anxu chuckled, slightly satisfied, "Congratulations on your promotion to Grandmaster. With your current strength, are you sure you can fight against Wei Zhou?"
"There is no guarantee of winning, but there is a guarantee of saving one's life. Let me tell you some good news. Last year, I slapped Zhou Mobai, but he didn't react."
Song Anxu covered her mouth and exclaimed, "You actually slapped Zhou Mobai? He, he hasn't reacted yet? Is he old or dying? Is he reacting so slowly?"
Chen Guanlou discovered that Song Anxu occasionally had a venomous tongue. The two of them really hit it off.
